notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {U} plus enough mana to cast the creature card in your hand.
easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand.
description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {U} plus enough mana to cast the creature card in your hand.
Cast the creature card by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Vedalken Mastermind by paying {U} and tapping it, returning the creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
